title: Sarbacher tells Strieber about Battelle materials

tellings.quote: Sam gave me Sarbacher's number and then he called me back and he said Sarbacher is waiting for you to call him. He's very eager to talk to you. So I call Sarbacher. Sarbucker proceeds to tell me all kinds of detail about the materials that he was dis was working on at the Battel Memorial Institute

plain: In the 1980s, a scientist named Robert Sarbacher is said to have described in detail the materials he had worked on at the Battelle Memorial Institute, a research institute. The author Whitley Strieber tells Michels he heard this himself: a man he calls only Sam gave him Sarbacher's number, then said Sarbacher was "very eager to talk", and on the phone Sarbacher told him "all kinds of detail" about the materials. If true, it would be a working scientist giving a first-hand account of hands-on work with them.
